basics.name: Roland Sharp
basics.label: AI-Augmented Software Engineer
basics.summary: I use AI coding assistants to build systems beyond what I could build alone. My current project, Vidya, is a neurosymbolic language model in OCaml — a 9.6M parameter transformer with a Forth interpreter constraining generation at the logit level, temporal difference learning for adaptive concept weights, and BLAS-accelerated matrix ops via C FFI. I directed the architecture and Claude Code wrote most of the implementation. The skill is knowing what to build, how to evaluate whether it's working, and how to steer an AI collaborator through a multi-week technical project. Before this, 5+ years building distributed systems in Node.js and TypeScript. Co-founder of JSON Resume (4.2K GitHub stars).

work.summary: Directing the build of Vidya, a neurosymbolic language model in OCaml with C FFI, using Claude Code as primary implementation partner. The system: a 9.6M parameter GPT-2 transformer with rotary position embeddings, weight tying, KV-cache, BPE tokenization (606 vocab), a Forth interpreter for symbolic constraint at the logit level, and temporal difference learning for adaptive concept associations. My role: architecture decisions, evaluation, steering multi-week AI-assisted development across 10+ source files. Read every line. Ran every test. Decided what to build next. Identified and fixed performance bottlenecks (optimized O(n*m) co-occurrence scan to O(n) indexed lookup). Published technical blog documenting the process and results.

Built the TypeScript client SDK and public data API for a decentralized cryptocurrency exchange. Expanded SQL knowledge into complex aggregate queries, worked with Ethereum and Cosmos JavaScript APIs, deployed AWS Lambda functions.

Maintained and built out the API gateway for an Australian cryptocurrency exchange. Built the initial market-starting arbitrage bot. TypeScript, GraphQL, TypeORM, Redis, JWT and TOTP multi-factor authentication.

Built a zero-knowledge query service for a consortium blockchain — the first company to use Hyperledger in production. Homomorphic encryption, private blockchain for immutable audit logs. 15+ Docker containers orchestrated with Docker Compose. Wrote all Golang chaincode. Deployed to IBM infrastructure.
Built the server for laplateforme.com, France's largest building construction hardware retailer. Mentored PHP developers on modern JavaScript. Node.js, Express.js, Mocha.js, MySQL.
Built the main REST API for beacon location tracking on Android devices. Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose.
Geo-monitoring applications using Node.js. Built modules for meteorological and geological data processing. Maintained 500+ end-to-end and unit tests.
Community-driven open-source initiative to create a JSON-based standard for resumes. Built the resume-cli tool (4.2K GitHub stars) and the registry server.

references.name: Thomas Davis
references.reference: I've known Roland for many years, and had the privilege of working closely with him at Blockbid, an Australian crypto currency exchange. Together we built out an API gateway which fronted a distributed system with Kubenetes on AWS. We used Open API v3 to define a schema for our public facing API, we built a custom schema validator which filtered out unexpected requests and responses improving security and consistency. We used JWT's to authenticate users on different microservices by passing them around with associated jobs in RabbitMQ. On top of this we managed to also support GraphQL and namely our own Apollo client frontend. He is excellent at Javascript/Typescript, writes readable, terse, documented and modular code.
